**SOCOM: U.S. Navy SEALs Fireteam Bravo Fusion Fix (PPSSPP)** adds right-stick controls, intro skipping, and an option to speed up game loading.

[Website](https://thirteenag.github.io/wfp#fireteambravo1) · [Source Code](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/WidescreenFixesPack/blob/master/source/SOCOM.FireteamBravo.PPSSPP.FusionFix/main.cpp)

</div>

---

## Options

- **Skip intro** — Skip startup intros.
- **Dual analog controls** — Enable right-stick support.
- **Loading** — Temporarily unthrottle the emulator during loading screens.

---

## Installation

1. Download the fix archive from this release.
2. Extract the archive into the directory containing PPSSPP’s `memstick` folder, preserving the folders in the archive.
3. Launch the game in PPSSPP once to create `memstick/PSP/PLUGINS/SOCOM.FireteamBravo.PPSSPP.FusionFix/SOCOM.FireteamBravo.PPSSPP.FusionFix.cfg`.
4. Change settings on fusionfix.io or in FusionFixHub, then restart the emulated game.

## Settings and compatibility

Intro skipping, right-stick controls and faster loading are enabled by default. Settings are saved in `SOCOM.FireteamBravo.PPSSPP.FusionFix.cfg` beside the plugin. Changes apply the next time the emulated game starts. An old `SOCOM.FireteamBravo.PPSSPP.FusionFix.ini` isn't used anymore and can be deleted.

There is no in-game settings menu. Some game releases may not support every fix. Choose widescreen and anti-aliasing in PPSSPP.

## Known limits

This fix does not correct HUD or menu proportions, change cutscene or movie framing, or add a 60 FPS mode. Unsupported patches are left disabled and reported in the plugin log and emulator debug output.

## Presets and FusionFixHub

- Presets: Vanilla turns off skip intro, dual analog controls and fast loading; Recommended (the defaults) and Enhanced turn them on.
- Setting texts: English, French, German, Italian and Spanish.
